# New-BulkADUser

Creates Active Directory user accounts in bulk from a CSV file, with -WhatIf and a simulation mode.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Changes the system** | Yes |
| **Supports `-WhatIf` / `-Confirm`** | Yes |
| **Admin rights** | AD permissions in AD mode; none for simulation/CSV mode |
| **PowerShell** | Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7+ |
| **Source** | [scripts/New-BulkADUser.ps1](https://github.com/lucaswsanchez/helpdesk-kb/blob/main/scripts/New-BulkADUser.ps1) &middot; [tests](https://github.com/lucaswsanchez/helpdesk-kb/blob/main/tests/New-BulkADUser.Tests.ps1) |

## Description

Reads new hires from a CSV (FirstName, LastName, Department, Title and optional Manager, Office) and, for each valid row:

- builds a SamAccountName as firstname.lastname (accents removed, lowercase, max 20 characters) and makes it unique, adding a number if the name is already taken in the CSV or in Active Directory
- builds the UPN and display name
- creates the account (disabled by default until the start date) with a random password and "change password at next logon"

The generated password is never written to the output or to disk: deliver credentials with a Temporary Access Pass or a supervised reset at handover (see KB-020).

Modes:

- AD mode: the ActiveDirectory (RSAT) module is available. Supports -WhatIf and -Confirm through ShouldProcess.
- Simulation mode: -Simulate is used, or the ActiveDirectory module is not installed. Nothing is created; the output shows what would happen. This lets you validate a CSV from any workstation.

Every row produces a result object (Row, SamAccountName, UPN, Status, Message) that can be exported as an audit log.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-CsvPath` | String | *required* | Path to the CSV file. Required columns: FirstName, LastName, Department, Title. Optional: Manager (SamAccountName), Office. |
| `-UpnSuffix` | String | `'acme.example'` | Domain used for the UserPrincipalName. Default: acme.example. |
| `-OrganizationalUnit` | String | `'OU=Users,OU=Acme,DC=acme,DC=example'` | Distinguished name of the OU where accounts are created. |
| `-Simulate` | switch |  | Force simulation mode even if the ActiveDirectory module is available. |
| `-Enabled` | switch |  | Create the accounts enabled. By default accounts are created disabled and enabled on the start date. |
| `-LogPath` | String |  | Optional path of a CSV file to write the results (audit log). |

## Examples

```powershell
.\New-BulkADUser.ps1 -CsvPath .\samples\new-hires.csv -Simulate
```

Validates the CSV and shows the accounts that would be created.

```powershell
.\New-BulkADUser.ps1 -CsvPath .\new-hires.csv -WhatIf
```

In AD mode, shows each New-ADUser operation without creating anything.

```powershell
.\New-BulkADUser.ps1 -CsvPath .\new-hires.csv -LogPath .\onboarding-log.csv
```

Creates the accounts and writes an audit log.

## Sample output

Real run in simulation mode against the sample CSV in this repository (no domain needed).

```powershell
.\New-BulkADUser.ps1 -CsvPath .\samples\new-hires.csv -Simulate | Format-Table Row, SamAccountName, UserPrincipalName, Status, Message
```

## Notes

Requires the ActiveDirectory module and rights to create users for AD mode. Works on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7+. Related KB: KB-020 New Employee Onboarding.
